title: Correct fringe type
description: Essential: Student must state that point P is a bright fringe (constructive interference).

title: Correct fringe spacing
description: Essential: Student must provide the correct numerical value for the fringe spacing, approximately 2.7 × 10⁻⁴ m.

title: Wavelength in air
description: Important: Student must correctly calculate the wavelength in air (λ₀) from the given medium wavelength and speeds, finding λ₀ = 5.4 × 10⁻⁷ m.

title: Path difference analysis
description: Important: Student must relate the given path difference (5.4 × 10⁻⁶ m) to the wavelength in air to determine the order of interference (m=10).

title: Fringe spacing formula
description: Important: Student must correctly apply the formula Δx = (lλ₀)/d to calculate the spacing between adjacent bright fringes.

title: Frequency consistency
description: Optional: Student may show that frequency remains constant when light passes between media, using f = v/λ.

title: Unit handling
description: Optional: Student demonstrates consistent unit conversion (e.g., mm to m) throughout the calculation.

title: Misinterpreting given wavelength
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses the provided medium wavelength (3.6 × 10⁻⁷ m) directly in air interference conditions.

title: Incorrect fringe condition
description: Pitfall: Student misapplies the condition for constructive/destructive interference (e.g., using λ/2 for bright fringe).
